# V4.1 selected specialist resources

This directory contains a deliberately bounded selection of upstream resources. It is not a whole-repository vendoring operation.

## Sources

- PaperSpine: `https://github.com/WUBING2023/PaperSpine`, commit `99a84fe452ab7681e30cd81387fcb6263a676125`, MIT. Imported 2026-09-20.
- Nature Skills: `https://github.com/Yuan1z0825/nature-skills`, commit `9cecfef6ac683fa59d7d15d2e22f98fa71dacaf5`, Apache-2.0. Imported 2026-09-20.

The selected files remain byte-identical to their upstream Git blobs. `source_manifest.json` records the exact local SHA-256 values and the provider-specific bundle hashes used by the runtime. The original license files are shipped beside the resources.

## Scope

The selected resources support only these advisory providers:

- `paperspine:contribution`
- `paperspine:results-validation`
- `paperspine:target-exemplar`
- `paperspine:publication-production`
- `nature:figure`
- `nature:reviewer`

No updater, downloader, web UI, remote-model client, credential handler, or external release automation was copied. The adapters use local files only and cannot grant formal scientific qualification.
